docs.title: Flori Input 用户手册
docs.text: Flori Input 是一款面向 Windows 的键鼠输入工具，支持重复输入、模拟粘贴和事件剧本。

docs.title: 入门
docs.text:
• 安装与更新：选择安装版或便携版，了解配置保存位置。
  • 快速开始：用三个小例子体验主要功能。

docs.title: 功能
docs.text:
• 触发器：鼠标或键盘连击、长按、固定坐标输入。
  • 模拟粘贴：把文本逐字发送到目标输入框，留空时可使用剪贴板文本。
  • 事件剧本：组合文字、按键、鼠标、等待和循环操作；附完整命令说明。

docs.title: 设置
docs.text: • 语言和外观：界面语言、主题和应用缩放。

docs.title: 事件剧本
docs.text: 事件剧本可以依次执行文字、键盘、鼠标、等待和循环操作，支持 text、stroke、event、wait、repeat、move 和 wheel。

docs.title: 文件与运行
docs.text:
将剧本保存为 UTF-8 文件（推荐 .fsevent ），放入软件“打开剧本目录”按钮打开的文件夹。便携版的该目录位于程序旁；安装版的位置见安装与更新。

页面只列出该目录第一层的 .fsevent 和 .txt 文件。选择文件时会自动检查；可以点击“编辑”用文本编辑器修改，保存后点击“刷新”。单个文件最多 1 MiB，允许 UTF-8 BOM。

保持软件停留在事件剧本页，切换到目标窗口后按启动热键（默认 F8 ）。再次按下可停止。启动前软件会重新读取并检查文件；若有错误，会在状态栏提示，不会执行部分内容。运行期间也会检查按键配对和屏幕布局变化。

三项功能的热键仅在各自页面生效；设置和关于页不响应启动热键。运行中切页会先停止当前任务。

docs.title: 参数单位
docs.text:
剧本的参数值不写单位。单位由所用参数决定：

参数 固定单位 示例 按压时间、字符间隔、等待时间 整数毫秒（ms） 250 表示 250 毫秒；仅按压时间和字符间隔允许 0 鼠标坐标 虚拟桌面物理像素 -1920, 100 滚轮 整数步数 -1 表示向下一步 循环次数 正整数次，或 -1 3 表示执行三次，-1 表示无限循环

不写 ms、s、px 等后缀，不按数值大小自动判断单位。时间只接受整数毫秒，上限 86400000；按压时间与字符间隔允许 0，wait(0) 无效，wait 至少为 1。0.5 等小数无效。坐标、滚轮与次数也必须为整数。

docs.title: 命令速查
docs.text:
以下是当前支持的全部命令；名称区分大小写。除 repeat 块外，每条命令均以 ; 结束。

命令 作用与参数 text("内容", press, interval); 逐字符输入 Unicode 文本；每个字符按压 press 毫秒，相邻字符间等待 interval 毫秒。两项均可为 0。 stroke(target[, target...], press); 按顺序按下一个或多个 Key.*/Mouse.* 目标，保持 press 毫秒后逆序抬起；最多 32 个目标，同一目标不可重复。 event(target, Down \| Up); 对单个 Key.*/Mouse.* 目标执行一次按下或抬起；不包含按压时长，必须配对，不得重复按下。 wait(ms); 暂停指定的整数毫秒；必须为 1～86400000，不接受 0。 repeat(count) { ... } 重复执行块内命令；count 为 1～1000000000，-1 表示无限循环。最多嵌套 16 层；无限循环必须包含时间推进。块后不加分号。 move(x, y); 将鼠标移至虚拟桌面的绝对物理像素坐标；支持负坐标，必须位于任一实际显示器。 wheel(steps); 在当前鼠标位置滚动；正数向上、负数向下，单次为 -100～-1 或 1～100 步。

docs.title: 命令详解
docs.text: 下列示例可直接写入 .fsevent 文件。时间参数均为整数毫秒，坐标为整个虚拟桌面的物理像素。

docs.title: text：输入文字
docs.text:
格式：text("内容", 按压时间, 字符间隔);。逐字使用 Unicode 输入，不依赖当前输入法。字符间隔只发生在同一条 text 的相邻字符之间，首尾不额外等待。

text("你好，Flori Input", 5, 20);

两个时间参数均可为 0。要输入双引号，在文本中写成 ""；反斜杠不表示转义，因此 \n 不会变成换行。换行请使用 stroke(Key.Enter, 5);。

docs.title: stroke：完整按压动作
docs.text:
格式：stroke(目标[, 目标...], 按压时间);。按给定顺序按下键盘键或鼠标键，保持指定时间，再逆序抬起。单个目标相当于一次按键或点击；多个目标可组成组合键。

stroke(Key.Ctrl, Key.A, 30);
stroke(Mouse.Left, 5);

目标必须写成 Key.名称 或 Mouse.名称，同一条命令不能重复目标，最多 32 个。按压时间可为 0 ，表示立即提交按下和抬起。组合键不做“是否有意义”的白名单判断。

docs.title: event：单次按下或抬起
docs.text:
格式：event(目标, Down); 或 event(目标, Up);。它只执行一步，不会自动等待或自动抬起，适合需要在按住期间穿插其他操作的场景。

move(300, 300);
event(Mouse.Left, Down);
wait(100);
move(600, 400);
event(Mouse.Left, Up);

每个 Down 都必须有对应的 Up；重复按下、无对应按下的抬起，或结束时仍有按住的目标，都会报错。停止或出错时软件会尝试释放已按下的输入。

docs.title: wait：暂停
docs.text:
格式：wait(毫秒);。在两项操作之间加入明确的等待，取值为 1～86400000，不能写 0 或小数。

stroke(Key.Enter, 5);
wait(250);
text("下一步", 5, 10);

docs.title: repeat：重复一段操作
docs.text:
格式：repeat(次数) { ... }。次数为 1～1000000000；-1 表示持续循环，直到再次按启动热键停止。最多嵌套 16 层，右花括号后不加分号。

repeat(3) {
    stroke(Mouse.Left, 5);
    wait(500);
}

无限循环必须包含实际耗时的操作，推荐明确写入 wait，避免无等待动作过多而被保护机制停止。循环次数不能为 0，除 -1 外也不能为负数。

docs.title: move：移动鼠标
docs.text:
格式：move(x, y);。坐标以整个虚拟桌面为基准；左侧或上方的副屏可能出现负坐标。点击事件剧本页的“捕获坐标”，将鼠标移到目标位置后左键确认，坐标会以 x, y 形式复制到剪贴板，可粘贴到 move(...) 中；右键或 Esc 取消。

move(400, 300);
stroke(Mouse.Left, 5);

请将示例坐标换成自己选取的位置。目标必须落在某块实际显示器内；若处于屏幕间空白区域，或运行时显示器布局已变化，剧本会报错，不会自动吸附到其他屏幕。

docs.title: wheel：滚动鼠标滚轮
docs.text:
格式：wheel(步数);。正数向上，负数向下；单次允许 -100～-1 或 1～100，不能写 0。

wheel(2);
wait(100);
wheel(-1);

docs.title: 语法与安全提示
docs.text:
字符串之外可以使用空格、缩进、换行和 // 行注释。命令与目标名称区分大小写，不支持别名。text 不允许跨行或包含控制字符；换行、Tab 等请使用对应的 Key.* 按键。

键盘目标名称支持 A～Z、0～9、F1～F24，以及 Ctrl、Shift、Alt、Win、Enter、Tab、Esc、Space、Backspace、 Delete、Insert、Home、End、PageUp、PageDown、ArrowLeft、ArrowRight、ArrowUp、ArrowDown。鼠标目标名称仅支持 Left、Middle、Right。

为防止意外长时间运行，有限剧本默认最多执行 10 万步，连续没有正时间等待的动作默认最多 1000 步；超限时会停止并尝试释放输入。需要无限循环时，请在循环体中加入合理的 wait，并确认启动热键可随时停止。

docs.title: 模拟粘贴
docs.text: 有些输入框不允许普通粘贴。模拟粘贴会把文字逐字符发送到当前目标窗口，适合在这些输入框中输入短文本；它不是剪贴板粘贴，也不能保证所有软件或受保护输入框都接受模拟输入。

docs.title: 使用方法
docs.text:
1. 停留在“模拟粘贴”页，在文本框中输入要发送的内容；如果留空，启动时会读取剪贴板里的最新文本。
  2. 选择输入策略，并按需要调整按压时间和输入间隔。
  3. 切到目标输入框，按启动热键（默认 F8）。任务完成后会自动停止；运行期间再次按热键可以提前停止。

启动热键可在本页单独修改，也可以与触发器或事件剧本使用相同键位；热键只对当前功能页生效。页面底部状态栏会显示运行结果或错误。

docs.title: 输入策略
docs.text:
• 模拟按键：优先发送可由键盘表达的按键；无法映射的字符会回退为 Unicode 输入。更适合依赖键盘事件的目标程序。
  • Unicode 字符：对每个字符直接发送 Unicode 输入，适合中文及其他非 ASCII 文本；部分游戏或特殊控件可能不接收。

可以先用记事本验证输出，再在目标应用里尝试。如果目标忽略某一种策略，切换另一种试试。

docs.title: 输入时间
docs.text:
界面中的时间单位是 秒，支持三位小数。按压时间默认 0.005 秒，表示每个字符按下到抬起的时长；输入间隔默认 0.010 秒，只发生在相邻字符之间，文本开始和结束时不额外等待。两项均可设为 0.000。

例如输入 ABC 且间隔为 0.100 秒，只会在 A/B 和 B/C 之间各等待一次，不会在 C 后再等待。

docs.title: 触发器
docs.text: 触发器适合重复点击、重复按键，或临时按住某个键。选择好输入后，切到目标窗口，按启动热键即可开始；再次按同一热键停止。默认热键为 F8，只有停留在“触发器”页面时生效。

docs.title: 设置输入
docs.text:
• 输入按键：可选鼠标左键、中键、右键，也可以点击“捕获”指定键盘按键或滚轮方向。自定义输入键不能与本页启动热键相同。
  • 输入行为：“连击”会反复执行按下、抬起；“长按”会保持按下，直到停止。滚轮只支持连击。
  • 光标移动：“自由”在当前指针位置执行鼠标操作；“固定”在指定坐标执行。使用坐标捕获时，移动指针到目标位置后左键确认，右键或 Esc 取消。坐标支持多显示器，左侧或上方屏幕可能出现负数。

docs.title: 连击时序
docs.text:
界面中的时间单位是 秒，支持三位小数，例如 0.010 为 10 毫秒。

  • 输入周期：两次输入开始之间的目标间隔，默认 0.010 秒。
  • 按压时间：每次保持按下的时间，默认 0.005 秒；0.000 表示立即提交按下与抬起。长按和滚轮不使用此项。
  • 动态误差：在目标周期附近加入随机变化，范围 0%～50%，默认 0%。

为了留出抬起时间，按压时间大于零时，最小周期为“按压时间 + 0.001 秒”；按压时间为零时，最小周期为 0.001 秒。实际速度还会受到 Windows 调度、目标软件和电脑负载影响，设置值不保证精确 CPS。

docs.title: 停止与状态
docs.text: 运行中再次按启动热键可停止，页面底部状态栏会显示运行或错误状态。停止时软件会尝试释放已按住的按键。建议先在不会造成误操作的窗口里确认热键和输入效果，再用于游戏或其他应用。

docs.title: 安装与更新
docs.text: Flori Input 面向 Windows。安装包和便携包可从项目 Releases 获取。下载前请核对发布者和文件名，不要从不明镜像获取安装包。

docs.title: 安装版
docs.text: 下载 Flori-Input-v<版本>-windows-x64-setup.exe 并按提示安装。升级前请停止正在运行的输入任务并关闭程序。

docs.title: 便携版
docs.text: 下载 Flori-Input-v<版本>-windows-x64-portable.zip，解压到可写目录后运行 Flori-Input.exe。不要直接从压缩包内启动。便携版的配置保存在程序目录的 config/config.jsonc，事件剧本放在同级的 scripts 目录；移动便携版时可一起移动这两个目录。

docs.title: 配置与剧本保存位置
docs.text:
安装版将配置和剧本保存在安装根目录，与 current 版本目录平级：

<安装根目录>\
├─ current\Flori-Input.exe
├─ config\config.jsonc
└─ scripts\

安装位置可能因安装方式而异。需要找到实际目录时，可先在“事件剧本”页点击“打开剧本目录”；其上一级就是安装根目录， config\config.jsonc 位于同一级。更新安装版时，config 和 scripts 不在 current 目录内，不会随版本目录一同替换。请保留这两个目录以备份设置和剧本。

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text: Flori Input 的三项输入功能分别位于“触发器”“模拟粘贴”“事件剧本”页。它们默认都使用 F8 作为启动热键，但 只响应当前功能页；运行中切换页面会先停止当前任务。

docs.title: 试一次鼠标连击
docs.text:
1. 打开“触发器”，保持默认的左键、连击和自由光标设置。
  2. 将鼠标移到可安全点击的位置，按 F8 开始，再按 F8 停止。
  3. 需要修改速度时，调整输入周期和按压时间；两者的界面单位都是秒。

docs.title: 试一次模拟粘贴
docs.text:
1. 打开“模拟粘贴”，输入一段短文本，或保持文本框为空以使用最新剪贴板文本。
  2. 在记事本里点选输入位置，按 F8；文字输入完毕后任务会自行结束。

docs.title: 试一个事件剧本
docs.text:
1. 打开“事件剧本”，点击“打开剧本目录”，新建 hello.fsevent。
  2. 用文本编辑器保存下面的 UTF-8 内容：
text("你好，Flori Input", 5, 20);
stroke(Key.Enter, 5);
  1. 回到软件，点击“刷新”并选择文件。切到记事本的输入位置后按 F8。完整语法见事件剧本。

如果状态栏显示错误，先检查输入目标、热键和剧本文件。不要在有未保存内容或可能触发危险操作的窗口中直接尝试自动化。

软件还使用 Slint、Glaze 和开源字体等第三方作品。它们各自保留原有版权和许可条件；请查阅第三方组件 及字体。软件界面中的 Slint 标识属于其权利人，不代表 Slint 对本项目的认可或担保。

docs.title: 字体许可
docs.text: Flori Input 内置的 FloriInputUI 字体组合了 Jura 的西文字形与 Sarasa UI SC 的中文字形，让中英文界面保持一致。它是派生字体，不是这两个项目提供的原版字体。

docs.title: FloriInputUI
docs.text: 对应的字体文件为 FloriInputUI-Medium.ttf。字体来源和许可信息如下。

docs.title: Jura
docs.text: Jura 的版权声明为“Copyright 2019 The Jura Project Authors”。原始声明及完整 SIL Open Font License 1.1 文本见 Jura 的 OFL 文件。

docs.title: Sarasa UI SC
docs.text: Sarasa UI SC 属于 Sarasa Gothic 字体系列。其版权声明还涵盖 Inter、Adobe 和 Google 的部分字形；请以 Sarasa Gothic 的许可证原文为准。

docs.title: 使用条件
docs.text: 两款来源字体均采用 SIL Open Font License 1.1 。该许可允许在软件中嵌入和分发修改后的字体，同时要求保留相应版权声明及许可证；上面的源项目页面提供原始声明和全文。其他第三方组件见第三方组件。

docs.title: 许可证
docs.text:
Flori Input 本体使用 MIT 许可证。该许可证允许使用、复制、修改和分发，但再分发时须保留版权与许可声明；具体条件以许可证原文为准。

内置的界面框架、序列化库与字体并不因为本项目采用 MIT 而改用 MIT。请分别查看第三方组件 和字体许可。

docs.title: 第三方组件
docs.text:
Flori Input 本体的许可见许可证。以下组件及素材遵循各自的许可条件：

组件 用途 许可与说明 Slint 1.17.1 用户界面 Royalty-free 许可证；项目 README 展示 Slint 署名标识。其依赖的许可见 Slint 官方清单。 Glaze 8.3.0 配置读取 Glaze 许可证。 Jura、Sarasa UI SC 内置界面字体的字形来源 均采用 SIL Open Font License 1.1，版权和原始许可见字体说明。 Slint 标识素材 关于页的 Slint 图形 来源于 Slint 项目；素材许可与使用条件见 CC BY-ND 4.0。

Windows 及 Microsoft 运行时库适用 Microsoft 的相关条款。本页是用户查找许可来源的入口，不替代各上游的正式许可文本。

docs.title: 合法使用与授权
docs.text:
Flori Input 是本地键鼠输入工具。使用前，请确认自己有权操作目标设备、账户和应用，并遵守适用法律及目标应用或服务的规则。

请勿将本工具用于未经授权的操作、骚扰或滥发信息、规避访问控制、侵害他人权益等行为。项目不提供此类用途的指导或定制支持。

自动输入会作用于当前目标窗口。启动前请核对目标、输入内容和停止热键，并先在安全窗口验证剧本或连续输入的效果。

本说明阐明项目用途与使用风险，不修改 MIT 许可证；软件的许可和责任条款以许可证原文为准。

docs.title: 语言和外观
docs.text: 在“设置”页调整界面语言、主题和应用缩放。选择会保存，重新启动后仍然生效。

docs.title: 界面语言
docs.text:
• 自动：根据 Windows 首选界面语言显示简体中文或英语。
  • 简体中文：使用中文界面。
  • English：使用英文界面。

界面语言不会改变事件剧本的命令名称；剧本命令始终使用英文。

docs.title: 主题
docs.text:
• 自动：跟随 Windows 的应用主题。
  • 深色：使用深色界面。
  • 浅色：使用浅色界面。

docs.title: 应用缩放
docs.text: 可选 100%、125%、150%，用于调整 Flori Input 的界面大小。

docs.title: Flori Input User Manual
docs.text: Flori Input is a Windows keyboard and mouse input tool for repeated input, simulated paste, and event scripts.

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text:
• Install and update: Choose an installer or portable package and find your configuration files.
  • Quick start: Try the three main features with short examples.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Trigger: Repeat or hold mouse buttons and keyboard keys, including input at a fixed position.
  • Simulated paste: Type text into a target field one character at a time, or use clipboard text when the field is empty.
  • Event scripts: Combine text, keys, mouse input, waits, and loops; includes a complete command reference.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: • Language and appearance: Change the interface language, theme, and scale.

docs.title: Event Scripts
docs.text: Event scripts run text, keyboard, mouse, wait, and loop operations in sequence. Supported commands are text, stroke, event, wait, repeat, move, and wheel.

docs.title: Files and execution
docs.text:
Save a script as a UTF-8 file (the .fsevent extension is recommended) in the folder opened by Open scripts folder in the app. For the portable package, this folder is next to the executable. For the installer, see Where settings and scripts are stored.

The page lists .fsevent and .txt files in that folder only, not in subfolders. The app validates a file when you select it. You can click Edit to change it in a text editor, then click Refresh after saving. Each file may be at most 1 MiB; a UTF-8 BOM is accepted.

Keep the Script page selected, switch to the target window, and press the start hotkey (default F8). Press it again to stop. Before starting, the app rereads and validates the file. If it finds an error, the status bar reports it and the app does not execute part of the script. It also checks input pairing and display layout changes while running.

Each of the three input pages responds only to its own hotkey while selected. The Set and Info pages do not respond to start hotkeys. Changing pages while running stops the current task first.

docs.title: Parameter units
docs.text:
Do not write units after parameter values. Each parameter has a fixed unit:

Parameter Unit Example Press duration, character interval, wait duration Integer milliseconds (ms) 250 means 250 ms; only press duration and character interval may be 0 Mouse coordinates Physical pixels in the virtual desktop -1920, 100 Wheel movement Integer steps -1 means one step down Repeat count Positive integer, or -1 3 runs three times; -1 repeats indefinitely

Do not add ms, s, or px, and do not infer a unit from the size of the number. Time values must be integer milliseconds up to 86400000. Press duration and character interval may be 0, but wait(0) is invalid: wait requires at least 1. Fractions such as 0.5 are invalid. Coordinates, wheel steps, and repeat counts must also be integers.

docs.title: Command reference
docs.text:
These are all supported commands. Names are case-sensitive. Every command except a repeat block ends with ;.

Command Purpose and parameters text("content", press, interval); Types Unicode text character by character. Holds each character for press ms and waits interval ms between adjacent characters. Both may be 0. stroke(target[, target...], press); Presses one or more Key.*/Mouse.* targets in order, holds them for press ms, then releases them in reverse order. At most 32 targets; no duplicates. event(target, Down \| Up); Presses or releases one Key.*/Mouse.* target once. There is no duration; presses and releases must be paired, and a held target cannot be pressed twice. wait(ms); Pauses for an integer number of milliseconds from 1 to 86400000; 0 is not accepted. repeat(count) { ... } Runs the enclosed commands repeatedly. count is 1–1000000000, or -1 for an indefinite loop. Up to 16 nesting levels; an indefinite loop must advance time. No semicolon after the block. move(x, y); Moves the pointer to absolute physical pixel coordinates in the virtual desktop. Negative coordinates are allowed; the point must be on an actual display. wheel(steps); Scrolls at the pointer's current position. Positive is up, negative is down; one command allows -100 to -1 or 1 to 100 steps.

docs.title: Commands in detail
docs.text: The following examples can be placed directly in a .fsevent file. Time parameters are integer milliseconds; coordinates are physical pixels in the full virtual desktop.

docs.title: text: type text
docs.text:
Syntax: text("content", press duration, character interval);. It uses Unicode input character by character and does not depend on the active input method. The interval applies only between adjacent characters in the same text command; there is no wait before the first or after the last character.

text("你好，Flori Input", 5, 20);

Both time values may be 0. To include a double quote, write "" inside the string. A backslash is not an escape character, so \n does not insert a newline. To insert a newline, use stroke(Key.Enter, 5);.

docs.title: stroke: complete press-and-release action
docs.text:
Syntax: stroke(target[, target...], press duration);. It presses the specified keyboard or mouse targets in order, holds them for the given duration, then releases them in reverse order. A single target is one keystroke or click; multiple targets can form a key combination.

stroke(Key.Ctrl, Key.A, 30);
stroke(Mouse.Left, 5);

Write targets as Key.Name or Mouse.Name. A command cannot repeat a target and may contain at most 32 targets. A press duration of 0 sends the press and release immediately. The app does not restrict key combinations to a list of predefined meaningful combinations.

docs.title: event: one press or release
docs.text:
Syntax: event(target, Down); or event(target, Up);. Each command performs one step without waiting or releasing automatically, so you can insert other operations while an input is held.

move(300, 300);
event(Mouse.Left, Down);
wait(100);
move(600, 400);
event(Mouse.Left, Up);

Every Down needs a matching Up. Pressing an already held target, releasing a target that is not held, or ending with a target still held causes an error. The app attempts to release held inputs when execution stops or fails.

docs.title: wait: pause
docs.text:
Syntax: wait(milliseconds);. Add an explicit pause between operations. The value must be from 1 to 86400000; 0 and fractional values are not accepted.

stroke(Key.Enter, 5);
wait(250);
text("Next step", 5, 10);

docs.title: repeat: repeat a block
docs.text:
Syntax: repeat(count) { ... }. The count must be 1–1000000000; -1 repeats until you press the start hotkey again. Blocks may be nested up to 16 levels. Do not add a semicolon after the closing brace.

repeat(3) {
    stroke(Mouse.Left, 5);
    wait(500);
}

An indefinite loop must contain an operation that takes time. An explicit wait is recommended so that the no-wait action limit does not stop the script. The count cannot be 0, and no negative number other than -1 is valid.

docs.title: move: move the pointer
docs.text:
Syntax: move(x, y);. Coordinates refer to the full virtual desktop. A secondary display to the left or above the primary display may have negative coordinates. Click Pick point on the Script page, move the pointer to the target, then left-click. The app copies the point as x, y to the clipboard so you can paste it into move(...). Right-click or press Esc to cancel.

move(400, 300);
stroke(Mouse.Left, 5);

Replace the example coordinates with a point you picked. The point must lie on an actual display. If it is in a gap between displays, or the display layout changes while the script runs, the app reports an error instead of snapping to another screen.

docs.title: wheel: scroll the mouse wheel
docs.text:
Syntax: wheel(steps);. Positive values scroll up and negative values scroll down. Each command accepts -100 to -1 or 1 to 100; 0 is invalid.

wheel(2);
wait(100);
wheel(-1);

docs.title: Syntax and safety
docs.text:
Outside strings, you may use spaces, indentation, newlines, and // line comments. Command and target names are case-sensitive; aliases are not supported. text cannot span lines or contain control characters. Use the corresponding Key.* target for Enter, Tab, and similar input.

Keyboard targets include A–Z, 0–9, F1–F24, Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Win, Enter, Tab, Esc, Space, Backspace, Delete, Insert, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, and ArrowDown. Mouse targets are limited to Left, Middle, and Right.

To prevent unexpectedly long runs, a finite script is limited to 100,000 steps by default, and no more than 1,000 actions may run consecutively without a positive-time wait. If a limit is exceeded, the app stops and attempts to release held inputs. For an indefinite loop, include a reasonable wait and make sure the start hotkey can stop it at any time.

docs.title: Simulated Paste
docs.text: Some text fields do not allow ordinary paste. Simulated paste sends text to the current target window one character at a time, making it useful for short text in such fields. It is not clipboard paste, and some apps or protected input fields may still reject simulated input.

docs.title: How to use it
docs.text:
1. Stay on the Sim Paste page and enter the text to send. If the text field is empty, the app reads the latest clipboard text when you start.
  2. Choose an input strategy and adjust Press and Interval if needed.
  3. Focus the target text field and press the start hotkey (default F8). The task stops automatically when finished; press the hotkey again to stop it early.

You can change this page's hotkey independently or use the same key as Trigger or Script. Hotkeys respond only on the current input page. The status bar at the bottom shows results or errors.

docs.title: Input strategies
docs.text:
• Simulate keys: Sends keyboard-representable characters as key events and falls back to Unicode input for characters that cannot be mapped. Better suited to apps that rely on keyboard events.
  • Unicode text: Sends every character using Unicode input. Useful for Chinese and other non-ASCII text, though some games and specialized controls may not accept it.

Try the output in Notepad before using it in the target app. If one strategy is ignored, try the other.

docs.title: Input timing
docs.text:
The UI uses seconds with up to three decimal places. Press defaults to 0.005 seconds and controls how long each character stays down. Interval defaults to 0.010 seconds and applies only between adjacent characters; there is no extra wait before or after the text. Both fields allow 0.000.

For example, with ABC and an Interval of 0.100 seconds, the app waits once between A and B and once between B and C, but not after C.

docs.title: Trigger
docs.text: Trigger is for repeated clicks or keystrokes, or temporarily holding a key. Choose the input, switch to the target window, and press the start hotkey to begin. Press the same hotkey again to stop. The default is F8, and it works only while the Trigger page is selected.

docs.title: Choose the input
docs.text:
• Button: Select the left, middle, or right mouse button, or click Pick to capture a keyboard key or wheel direction. A custom input key cannot be the same as this page's start hotkey.
  • Action: Repeat presses and releases the input repeatedly; Hold keeps it pressed until you stop. The wheel supports Repeat only.
  • Cursor: Free performs mouse input at the pointer's current position; Lock uses a specified coordinate. To pick a coordinate, move the pointer to the target, left-click to confirm, or right-click or press Esc to cancel. Coordinates span all monitors, so a screen to the left or above the primary display can have negative coordinates.

docs.title: Repeat timing
docs.text:
The UI uses seconds with up to three decimal places. For example, 0.010 means 10 milliseconds.

  • Period: Target interval between the starts of two inputs; defaults to 0.010 seconds.
  • Press: How long each input stays down; defaults to 0.005 seconds. 0.000 sends the press and release immediately. Hold and wheel input do not use this setting.
  • Jitter: Adds random variation around the target period. The range is 0%–50%, and the default is 0%.

When Press is above zero, the minimum Period is Press plus 0.001 seconds, leaving time to release the input. When Press is zero, the minimum Period is 0.001 seconds. Actual speed also depends on Windows scheduling, the target app, and system load; the configured values do not guarantee an exact clicks-per-second rate.

docs.title: Stopping and status
docs.text: Press the start hotkey again while running to stop. The status bar at the bottom of the page shows running and error states. On stop, the app attempts to release any held inputs. Confirm the hotkey and input behavior in a safe window before using them in a game or another app.

docs.title: Install and Update
docs.text: Flori Input runs on Windows. Installer and portable packages are available from the project Releases. Check the publisher and filename before downloading, and avoid untrusted mirrors.

docs.title: Installer
docs.text: Download Flori-Input-v<version>-windows-x64-setup.exe and follow the installer prompts. Before updating, stop any active input task and close the app.

docs.title: Portable package
docs.text: Download Flori-Input-v<version>-windows-x64-portable.zip, extract it to a writable directory, then run Flori-Input.exe. Do not run the app directly from the ZIP. The portable package stores settings in config/config.jsonc next to the app and event scripts in the neighboring scripts directory. You can move both directories with the portable app.

docs.title: Where settings and scripts are stored
docs.text:
The installer stores settings and scripts in the installation root, alongside the current version directory:

<installation root>\
├─ current\Flori-Input.exe
├─ config\config.jsonc
└─ scripts\

The actual installation location depends on how the app was installed. To find it, click Open scripts folder on the Script page. Its parent is the installation root; config\config.jsonc is alongside scripts. Because config and scripts are outside current, an installer update does not replace them with the version directory. Keep copies of both directories when backing up your settings and scripts.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text: Flori Input has three input pages: Trigger, Sim Paste, and Script. All use F8 as their default start hotkey, but only the current input page responds. Changing pages while a task is running stops that task first.

docs.title: Try repeated mouse clicks
docs.text:
1. Open Trigger and leave the default Left button, Repeat action, and Free cursor settings unchanged.
  2. Move the pointer to a safe place to click. Press F8 to start, then press F8 again to stop.
  3. To change the speed, adjust Period and Press. Both fields use seconds.

docs.title: Try simulated paste
docs.text:
1. Open Sim Paste and enter a short phrase, or leave the text field empty to use the latest clipboard text.
  2. Place the text cursor in Notepad and press F8. The task stops automatically when all text has been sent.

docs.title: Try an event script
docs.text:
1. Open Script, click Open scripts folder, and create hello.fsevent.
  2. Save the following UTF-8 text in that file:
text("Hello, Flori Input", 5, 20);
stroke(Key.Enter, 5);
  1. Return to the app, click Refresh, and select the file. Focus Notepad's input area and press F8. See Event Scripts for the complete syntax.

If the status bar shows an error, check the target window, hotkey, and script file. Do not first try automation in a window with unsaved work or where an unintended action could be harmful.

docs.title: Responsible Use and Authorization
docs.text:
Flori Input is a local keyboard and mouse input tool. Before using it, make sure you are authorized to operate the target device, account, and application, and follow applicable laws and the rules of the target app or service.

Do not use this tool for unauthorized operations, harassment or spam, bypassing access controls, or infringing others' rights. The project does not provide guidance or custom support for such uses.

Automated input affects the current target window. Before starting, check the target, input content, and stop hotkey, and test scripts or repeated input in a safe window first.

This notice explains the project's intended use and associated risks. It does not change the MIT License; the license text governs the software's licensing and liability terms.

docs.title: Language and Appearance
docs.text: Change the interface language, theme, and app scale on the Set page. Your choices are saved and remain in effect after restarting.

docs.title: Interface language
docs.text:
• Auto: Uses Simplified Chinese or English according to the preferred Windows display language.
  • 简体中文: Uses the Chinese interface.
  • English: Uses the English interface.

The interface language does not change event-script command names; commands are always written in English.

docs.title: Theme
docs.text:
• Auto: Follows the Windows app theme.
  • Dark: Uses the dark theme.
  • Light: Uses the light theme.

docs.title: Scale
docs.text: Choose 100%, 125%, or 150% to adjust the Flori Input interface size.
